start.text:
PROJECT DEVIL_I // SYSTEM EMERGENCY LOG

Location: Subsurface Containment Complex Theta.
Time: 03:14:00 // ZERO HOUR BREACH.

Warning: Anomaly DEVIL_I has severed bio-containment seals. Heavy metallic footsteps and electromagnetic screeching reverberate down the server corridor. Atmospheric oxygen levels dropping.

camera_check_node.text: CRITICAL TRANSMISSION: Accessing Thermal Camera Feeds CAM-01 through CAM-04. Scan the feeds to track the cybernetic apparition before it reaches your command deck!

terminal_hack_node.text: AIRLOCK SECURITY BYPASS: Terminal encrypted by rogue entity! Input the emergency override passkeys under time pressure to secure blast door Alpha.

biometric_pulse_node.text: PROXIMITY WARNING: Anomaly DEVIL_I is standing directly behind the reinforced viewport! Activate Biometric Pulse Dampener—PRESS & HOLD to stabilize your heartbeat. Do NOT let your pulse spike or release the dampener button!

frequency_tuner_node.text: SIGNAL INTERCEPTOR: Heavy demonic frequency interference detected. Align the target radio frequency band to call for Subsurface Evacuation Craft!

stairs_up.text: You march down server corridor Alpha. Spilled synthetic coolants hiss on hot copper pipes. Black bio-cables writhe like serpents along the ceiling. Sector B door hums with dark energy.

call_out.text: You broadcast your voice over the facility intercom: 'Is anyone remaining alive?' Static crackles... then a distorted synthetic voice whispers back: 'WE ARE DEVIL_I. WE LIVE IN YOUR HARDWARE.'

hallway_wait.text: You press your ear against the bulkhead. Synchronized synthetic breathing echoes inside your audio headset... But then you realize the sound isn't from the speaker. Something cold is breathing directly onto your neck.

bedroom_trap.text: You breach Sector B. In the center of the bio-chamber, a towering cybernetic demon stands hooked to neural conduits. Its skull twists 180 degrees with a sickening mechanical snap, locking glowing crimson optics onto yours.

jumpscare_breach.text: SECURITY BREACH SYSTEM CRITICAL! DEVIL_I shatters the viewport glass! Metal claws pierce your terminal console as dark digital corruption floods your visual HUD!

locked_in.text: You seal the blast door. Heavy locking pins drop with a dull thunder. But as you turn around, the terminal displays: 'CONTAINMENT AIRLOCK SEALED. LIFE SUPPORT TERMINATED.' Frost spreads across your visor.

escape_attempt.text: You burst through the emergency gate, stumbling onto the frozen surface crater under the dark crimson sky. Sirens wail behind you as facility shields collapse. You escaped... for now.

orbital_escape.text: SUCCESSFUL EVACUATION! The escape capsule fires thrusters, hurtling you into space away from subsurface facility Theta. DEVIL_I burns in the atomic explosion below.

entity_consumed.text: NEURAL OVERRIDE COMPLETE. DEVIL_I has merged with your brain architecture. You are no longer human. You are the host.

core_purge.text: THERMAL PURGE INITIATED. 10,000°C plasma floods Sector B. You and the cybernetic nightmare dissolve into molten vapor.

possessed_ai.text: TRANSMISSION HIJACKED. DEVIL_I routed its core intelligence into your radio signal. Global network infection in 3... 2... 1...
